page.layout: One printed page of running text in one column. Right margin: a note "Bubula à quibusdam cur improbata ?" beside the paragraph starting "Quidam", and a mark "NB" beside the last paragraph. Catchword "utpote" at the lower right below the last line.

main_text.p: altiles pleneque saginatos mittunt. Sed & hodie in plerusque Germania locis saginati amplitudinisq; dignitate spectabiles atque insignes cernuntur. Est vero certa boves saginandi ars, qua ad tantam pinguitudinis molem eos extumescere faciat. Galenus herba adulta & proceriore facta, jamq; ad semen properante boves optimiores, crassiores bonoq; succo pleniores fieri censet.

¶Multi herba autumnali & post prata secta proveniente, eleganter saginari boves existimant, quem morem multi germania populi studiose observant, in isto enim pabuloBubula à quibusdam cur improbata ? mul-tum emolumenti esse compererunt.

Quidam bubula al mentum in sanitate proroganda improbant; atramq; bilem, crassiorem q; gene-rare sanguinem affirmant, propterea q; largius crebrius q; ea vescentes, si obnoxii fuerint, alicui aegritudini splenicae, ut quartanae, scabiei, lepra, cibo esuq; eius oportuniores reddi, facili-usq; tentari. Verum de sale condita & suspen-sa id accipiendum. In amplis enim familiis boves ma es[?] simul ac foemina conduntur ad ci-baria annua famulorum operarumq;, deinde muria exemta pensilis servatur caro, qua adeo induratur, ut longiori etiam coctura postea per-tinacissime dometur, gustatuq; interdum suavi-tatem referat nullam.NB: Potores hac commendata sibi habent tanq; acerrimum situs stimulü, aq; ac pernas fullas[?]. Ego otiosis et sellularis[?], literarumq; studiosis parcius hanc attingendam praemoneo,

page.notes: Page number printed as "46ȝ" in old form, read as 463. Running head "PROROGANDA." set in capitals with a long R. "Quidam" is split across the line end without a visible hyphen. Marginal note in the right margin is set in two-line fragments and is joined here. "boves ma es" has irregular spacing; the word may be "mas" and is marked [?]. "pernas fullas" and "sellularis" are doubtful. "optimiores" is read from "optim ores" with a gap. Printed "NB" mark in the margin is read as "NB:" with uncertainty. The paragraph mark before "Multi" is a printed sign. The word "adulta" is followed by a dash-like mark at the line end, not counted as a hyphen. Long s is transcribed as s throughout, e.g. "saginati", "crassiores", "pensilis".
